claim: Tekla bolt-assembly flag code (6 decimal digits d5..d0) = [holes only (bolt off), washer under the HEAD, washer 2, washer under the NUT, nut 1, nut 2]

where.8.x/9.x DB1: int at bolt attribute record +301 (8.53 stride-317 record; db1_v2 re/bolt853)

proof: BSA Ardent Cancer Center, Tekla 8.53 DB1 joined to its Tekla IFC export (29903.ifc) by object GUID: 1,841 bolt groups with a shank. Per group the IFC mapped bolt geometry was split relative to the shank (head ends at the shank start; washers = circles wider than 1.3 d and not the hole; head-side washer starts at the shank start; nut-side washers elsewhere; nuts = hex polygons beyond the shank start).

result.mismatch_flags: 011110 (4 groups: W1+W2+W3+N1; IFC shows a DTI ring + 1 nut-side washer, no head washer)
result.holes_only_100000: 832 groups: IFC holds hole cylinders only, no shank

by_flag.ifc: washer under the nut + 1 nut (0 head-side washers)
washer under the head + washer under the nut + 1 nut
washer under the head, no nut

use: d4 = 1 -> one washer between head and first ply; d2 = 1 -> one washer between last ply and nut 1; d3 (washer 2) seen only in 4 groups (side not proven: leave inferred); d1/d0 -> nuts; d5 = 1 -> cut holes, write no bolt.
